description: Eight inputs, each switched onto one of two summing buses or off, with each bus repeated across eight output jacks

params.text: Routes that input to the A bus, to the B bus, or to neither.

inputs.text: The signal that row sends to whichever bus its switch selects.
Adds to that row's switch: about 3.2V or more selects B, and about -3.2V or less selects A.

outputs.text: The sum of every input switched to A, carried identically on each of the A jacks.
The sum of every input switched to B, carried identically on each of the B jacks.

notes: every A-OFF-B switch comes up centred on OFF, so a new module sends nothing to the A or B outputs until a switch is moved.
menu: Type — chooses whether the two buses sum the inputs routed to them as they are, under Positive, or with their phase inverted, under Negative.
